segments.text: Day 11 · Reverse proxies, API gateways, service mesh basics।
What: The layers that sit in front of (reverse proxy, API gateway) or between (service mesh) your services, handling routing, auth, and observability.
How to complete: Explain what an API gateway adds on top of a plain reverse proxy, and when a service mesh (e.g.
Istio) becomes worth its operational cost.
